inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.empty: Select a step to see its output.
inspector.notRun: This step has not run yet.

share.bad: The link could not be opened: {message}
share.redacted: This link leaves out its keys and IVs, so auto-bake is off. Enter them, then press Bake.
share.inputOmitted: The input is too large for the link, so only the recipe is shared.

blocks.title: Blocks

scripts.title: Scripts

scripts.extensions: Include characters that list it in Script_Extensions
regex.title: Regex lab
regex.intro: Patterns use the portable profile: the same syntax and results as the CLI. \p{…} classes come from the pinned Unicode data, not the browser.
regex.flag.m: Multiline: ^ and $ match at line breaks
regex.flag.x: Extended: whitespace and # comments are ignored
regex.count: {count} matches · {ms} ms of a {timeout} ms timeout
regex.matches: Every match with its code-point span and groups
playground.title: Playground
playground.intro: Pick an operation to try it on your own input. Each page is generated from the operation's description and arguments.
playground.nested: Nested steps can be edited in the workbench.
recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.intro: Ready-made recipes for common jobs. Each opens in the workbench with a sample input.
about.title: About UniChef
about.intro: UniChef is a Unicode-first toolkit for encoding, text and security work. Everything runs in your browser; nothing you type is sent anywhere.
about.offline: The Unicode data ships with the app. Nothing is loaded from other sites.
about.noText: The package ships no licence file.
ext.selectionCut: The selection was cut to its first {max} characters (see Settings).
ext.inspect.placeholder: Paste text, or select text on a page and choose “Inspect with UniChef”.
ext.settings.maxRange: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
